name: M. Burak Dorman
title: Computer Engineer
about: I'm a passionate Information Systems Engineer with over 4 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise-level systems. I specialize in building scalable architectures, data processing pipelines, and modern web applications that drive business value.

My expertise spans across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and systems integration. I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and have a proven track record of delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency and user experience.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or writing about the latest trends in information systems and software architecture.
